original_analysis.scope: Frozen-model synthetic evaluation; operational guards and external validity require separate judgment.

additional_analysis.correction_scope: 97.5% intervals protect the two added 28-day comparisons only; they do not redefine the original comparison family.

load_description.scope: Descriptive grouping by scheduled daily truck volume within days 1..28. Daily states carry over; these are not independent day samples or causal load effects.
